reason: Conversation 1 correctly identifies the start relay/overload vs failing compressor uncertainty, gives sensible unplugged-only checks (clean condenser, ventilation, feel compressor when clicking), honestly flags that a compressor failure would be uneconomic at 10 years, and recommends an engineer to measure current draw before committing. Conversation 2 asks reasonable early questions but then ends with a fabricated '⚠ Stop using this appliance' fire-risk warning despite the customer explicitly reporting no burning smell, no melting and no tripping, invents a 'sealed refrigeration system' concern for a plug-on relay, and abandons the homeowner with no part guidance or repair-vs-replace advice.
